name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: ECMWF wet-bulb-zero Snowline proxy to +144 h with stitched 100 m contours, persistent Windy map-elevation probes with prominent above/below/near-snowline status, adaptive sampling, caching, decluttered labels, and a centered in-map loading indicator.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
